title: Going-to-the-Sun Road
direction: Crosses Glacier National Park from West Glacier, along Lake McDonald and up to Logan Pass on the Continental Divide, then down to St. Mary. Vehicle size limits, seasonal closures and timed-entry rules apply; check the National Park Service before you go.

stretches.line: The descent toward the park's east side.
